changes.to: Maker press release (CES 2026, via PR Newswire): the flagship AstroDroid AD-01 stands 170 cm tall with 43 DoF, runs on Jetson AGX Orin and is fully integrated with the Hyper-VLA model; the AstroDroid series is a general-purpose wheeled humanoid line. Maker news (May 2026) shows AD-01 completing a five-item quick-commerce order end to end in a Hangzhou front warehouse. Mass, payload, speed, battery and price are not published.
INFIFORCE's full-size wheeled AstroDroid AD-01, driven by the company's Hyper-VLA model for warehouse order picking and packing.
